author: Home
title: Here Comes Nvidia's Latest Powerful Graphics Chip - TheStreet
text:
So starts the U.S. trade war with China.
Street Rumors Coca-Cola ( KO ) could make a play for BodyArmor once Dr. Pepper Snapple Group ( DPS ) completes its merger with Keurig on July 9. Dr. Pepper Snapple owns 15.5% of the upstart sports drink brand. A purchase would post a clear threat to PepsiCo's ( PEP ) dominance with Gatorade. Meanwhile, Nvidia ( NVDA ) is reportedly about to release a key new graphic chip.
Nvidia and PepsiCo are holdings in Jim Cramer's Action Alerts PLUS .
Call of the Day Bernstein analysts are out with a note projecting a "Super Spike" in oil prices to $150 a barrel. The reason: years of under-investment by oil majors such as ExxonMobil ( XOM ) .
The Big Story The U.S. trade war has kicked off. Watch the trading action in "China Stocks" such as Apple ( AAPL ) and Walmart ( WMT ) .
Apple is a holding in Jim Cramer's Action Alerts PLUS .
